title: Sign at the Sheds Past the Last House
summary: Alys Mattock says something is out at the edge of Emberfall: paper nests under the eaves and stung livestock. Learn what it is, then put it down.
offer_text: "There is sign at the sheds past the last house: paper nests under the eaves and stung livestock. I cannot tell how many, or how bold. Read it for me, and then put them down."
turn_in_text: "Now we know what we are dealing with, and it is dealt with."

objectives.text: Find two signs of the giant wasps around the edge of Emberfall
Tell Alys Mattock what you found

relationship.label: Read the sign and acted on it
